_doc: TENANT-SYNC-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-17): the core in workers/ is the only source of generic code; tenants are test beds that pin it by hash and never diverge. Every repository of the organization has a role here; `python3 -m foundation.tenantsync --check` fails on an unclassified repository. The backend does all of this and records it in ops/tenant-sync/ledger.jsonl; a user of any system never sees it.

ultrastable.why: holds workers/, the only source of generic code

workers.why: retired 2026-11-17; core lives in ultrastable/ultrastable workers/

.github.why: organization profile and shared workflow templates

business.why: archived; its content lives in ultrastable/ultrastable

docs.why: archived; its content lives in ultrastable/ultrastable

ip.why: archived; its content lives in ultrastable/ultrastable

platform.why: archived; its content lives in ultrastable/ultrastable

site.why: archived; its content lives in ultrastable/ultrastable

future_tenant_rule: A new system built on Ultrastable is a tenant: add it here and give it upstream.json; the bootstrap does both (seed/bootstrap).
